phase: Phase E end-to-end replay + projection at fixed checkpoint
summary: Replay core graph to an explicit checkpoint (prefix of a longer history), then materialize the prefix projection and walk deterministic paged reads.
Assert canonical map hash parity and full-projection digest parity across two independent replays (core) or two room imports (server).
Paged reconstruction must match full row order and projection_digest(rebuilt) == projection_digest(full).
notes: This run-03 lane intentionally complements run-01/02: those capture suite timing/Criterion pressure; run-03 pins semantic E2E behavior across replay boundary + pagination read path.
Sustained synthetic cardinality scaling remains an optional future benchmark expansion if product SLOs require it.
